admission.justification: Receipt-locked fencing in cli/role_held_store.py and lockless counting in controlplane/held_store_layout.py prevent closed seats from recreating removed task folders and are proved by closed-store tests.

applicability: All held-store write paths (role messages, developer delivery, tick, sweep, drain, late close) and read/count helpers.
conditions: Every store mutation opens through open_held_store under the launch receipt lock and verifies live identity and generation.
Missing-store counts read without acquiring a store lock or creating directories.
exclusions: Deliberate same-request restarts advance heldStoreGeneration through begin_held_generation for the new generation.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Held-store writes to a closed or superseded launch generation refuse before creating a store, and counts of missing stores create nothing.
title: Closed or superseded seats refuse store writes; missing counts create none
